text:
Priya Singh: Heads-up — enterprise customer (acme-ai) reports intermittent bad embeddings from /v1/embeddings during high throughput. They see some requests return 0-length vectors and others 400 dimension-mismatch when we coalesce requests. Happens after they turned on a client-side rate window.
Julian Park: ugh. any error examples/ids?
Priya Singh: yes, from their logs: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Request-ID: r-8f3a2c
payload: [[0.1, 0.2,...]] (single input)
Response: 200 OK, embeddings: []  <-- zero-length array
```
and later: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Request-ID: r-8f3a5d
Response: 400 Bad Request: embedding dimension mismatch (expected 1536 got 0)
```
Omar Reyes: Do we have dynbatch coalesce logs around those Request-IDs? Could be partial deserialization when coalescing fractured frames.
Maya Chen: customer said they enabled a short retry/backoff and token-bucket window which sends many tiny requests in bursts. That could trigger coalescing window oddities.
infra-bot: Found coalesce logs for r-8f3a2c on node gpu-14: `coalesce: grouped 7 reqs -> batch_size=7 total_tokens=1548 latency=12ms`
Priya Singh: interesting — but the batch_size shows 7, and one of the payloads seems to have empty input after coalesce. Possibly a client-side empty string got serialized as [] and wasn't validated.
Julian Park: Can we repro locally? steps I want: a) run dynbatch with max_batch_size=64 and coalesce_window_ms=10 b) send many tiny embedding requests with varying payload lengths, include a few intentionally empty inputs c) capture the coalesce debug trace and per-request payloads before kernel input pack.
Priya Singh: I already asked customer to run with DEBUG and share request traces. They provided a truncated trace: 
```
coalesce_trace: [r-8f3a29, r-8f3a2c, r-8f3a31, r-8f3a5d]
prepack_payloads: [["hello"],[""],["world"],["foo"]]
packed_matrix_shape: (4, 1536)
unpack_map: [0, NULL, 2, 3]
```
They claimed the second entry unpacked as NULL and produced zero-dim embedding.
Omar Reyes: That unpack_map NULL is the smoking gun. If we hit a serialization bug where empty string -> NULL and we don't validate shape, downstream embedding kernel receives a ragged tensor.
Maya Chen: Agreed. quick mitigation: 1) tell customer to set max_batch_size=1 or disable coalescing (coalesce_window_ms=0) to avoid mixing payloads until we patch. 2) server-side: add validation for empty inputs before pack and return 400 with clear message.
Priya Singh: Customer asked for a config recommendation they can apply immediately. I'll push the mitigation.
infra-bot: Suggested patch queued: validate_prepack_inputs: return 400 on empty input — PR #4523.
Julian Park: Also check for an edge-case where client sends `[]` vs `""` — different SDKs may encode empty text as empty list. We should normalize both.
Maya Chen: Could also be related to dynamic batching when combined with per-client rate window — we saw earlier a bug where the coalescer would reuse a buffer slot without clearing when a slot had zero-length payload. I'll look at ringbuffer.clear_index() calls.
Omar Reyes: For troubleshooting steps to ask customer: please capture the following and paste here: 
- exact Request-IDs (r-*) for failures
- the raw HTTP bodies for those requests
- server coalesce_trace lines and prepack_payloads (we already got a good one)
- their client SDK version and any custom serialization (protobuf/json)
Also ask them to repro with small script I can share.
Priya Singh: I'll send them a repro script. Draft: 
```
# minimal repro (python)
for i in range(1000):
  body = {"input": "" if random.random()<0.01 else "test %d"%i}
  resp = requests.post(ENDPOINT, json=body, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer ..."})
  print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```
I'll tell them to run with coalesce_window_ms=5 and then with 0.
Julian Park: Also capture kernel input pack logs: `pack_input_matrix batch_id=... shapes=[...]` — that will show if we padded weirdly.
support-bot: customer escalated to P2 (customer impact: some embeddings empty/mismatch). Ticket #INC-4421.
Maya Chen: If we can't get a quick repro, temporary workaround on our side: add an inbound validation gate in the edge node (reject empty arrays/strings). Low-risk and fast deploy.
Omar Reyes: Agree — I'll put up a hotfix to validate non-empty strings before pack. If we find reuse of buffer without clear, patch that too.
Priya Singh: client applied temporary setting: coalesce_window_ms=0 and reported no more empty embeddings after 30m. They can keep that until hotfix.
Julian Park: Good. Follow-up items: 
- Omar: hotfix PR and deploy to canary by EOD (validate_prepack_inputs + buffer clear)
- Maya: add telemetry to coalesce logs to include unpack_map indexes + reason for NULL
- Priya: gather final confirmation from customer and close P2 once stable
Priya Singh: leaving checklist in the ticket and will paste final logs here when customer confirms. Thanks all :thumbsup:
